records.text: Breland reported that campaign Google Drive files appeared to have been uploaded by Enclave and Key employees Jules Katz, Benjamin Goodman, and Jack O’Hara; Katz and O’Hara seemed to use company email addresses, and O’Hara also appeared to use a personal address. He said Enclave and Key’s role, if any, was not specified and the Discord server did not identify campaign payers.
records.speaker: Ali Breland

appearances.snippet: The article continues. The Discord server doesn't specify who is paying elephant clipping or the other right-leaning political clipping operations, but Google Drive folders in each of the campaigns are filled with files uploaded by what appears to be three employees of Enclave and Key, a Las Vegas-based marketing company. ... Jules Katz, the chief of staff, Benjamin Goodman, a vice president of operations, and Jack O'Hara, the head of media production at an Enclave and Key subsidiary. ... O'Hara (Jack O'Hara) and Katz (Jules Katz) seem to have uploaded videos to the Google Drive with their company email address. In at least one instance, O'Hara (Jack O'Hara) also used what appears to be his personal email address. It's not specified what role, if any, Enclave and Key plays in the campaign.

conveyance.original_source: The Atlantic, Inside a Conservative Operation to Hijack Your Social Media Feed, as read in the episode

records.text: Breland reported that after he contacted the Wynns, Enclave and Key, and others, Google Drive folders uploaded by Katz and O’Hara disappeared and Goodman reposted the files using an email not linked to Enclave and Key; campaign Discord listings and descriptions were removed, and the company’s campaign Google Drives were taken down Friday morning.
records.speaker: Ali Breland

appearances.snippet: Steve Wynn, Blake (Blake Wynn)'s uncle, did not respond to a request for comment. Shortly after I first reached out to both Wynn's, Enclave and Key and others that were involved in the campaigns, the deletions started. ... By Thursday afternoon, video folders for clippers that had been uploaded to a Google Drive by Katz (Jules Katz) and O'Hara (Jack O'Hara) had disappeared. ... Though the same files were then posted by Goodman (Benjamin Goodman), who used an email address not linked to Enclave and Key, the Discord channels for U.S. politics clipping and elephant clipping were also delisted from the publicly visible campaigns in the ClipSon and Clip It discords. The Campaigns were still visible on Monster Lab, but descriptions explaining the purpose of each campaign were gone. ... On Friday morning, Enclave and Key's Google Drives for the campaigns were taken down as well. Blake Wynn has connections beyond his uncle in the conservative media sphere.
